paragraphs.text: The Church of Serra , also called Serranism , is a religion on Dominaria , dedicated to the goddess Serra , who actually was a planeswalker . Its main manifestation are the Serra Angels .
The origins of the religion can be traced back thousands of years to the moment when the planeswalker first visited Dominaria and created her first angels.

In the days of the Sheoltun Empire , Benalia 's forerunner, the growing settlement of Epityr rebelled against the Sheoltun. During the Uprising in Epityr , a priest of Serra called forth the Serra Angels to free the town. This rebellion was the last straw, and the weakened Sheoltun Empire soon after lost all control of eastern Terisiare. A lingering resentment against the Church of Serra turned most Benalkin towards the Church of Angelfire , and after the Founding of Benalia , Serranism was banned in that nation for centuries.

However, with the influx of refugees from Serra's Realm after the destruction of that plane, the Church of Serra experienced a revival in Benalia. The village of Devas was established, and with the help of Urza , obtained friendly relations with specifically Clan Capashen , by training the scions of that house in military matters. By the the time of the Phyrexian Invasion , Serra Angels were openly helping the Benalish and currently it is the main religion again. Only House Croger are still Angelfire traditionalists. The new arrivals created floating buildings reminiscent of their home plane, all with round turreted roofs and elegant high arches, the brilliant colors of the window glass glowing in the sunlight.

The religion was strengthened throughout Dominaria when a man who was known as Brother Angus built the Cathedral of Serra around Serra's tomb on the Plains of Sursi . Serra had blessed the land with her passing, to be a sanctuary against the dark forces that assailed her followers. To this day, Serra Angels sometimes spontaneously appear in the Cathedral.

In Serra's Realm, the four virtues of the Church of Serra were codified: art, discourse, freedom, and peace. This is also represented in the quartered circle, one of the symbols of the Serran faith. Another one is the pentagon, representing the five points of balance: law, duty, reason, grace, and truth. Serra's worldview, beliefs, prophecies, and wisdom are chronicled in the Song of All .

The church was formerly led by the Serran Mother Superior . According to myths she blessed the Hand of Righteous Retribution , alongside the High Primate of Angelfire . This is a bold claim, as the Church of Angelfire has long opposed the Serrans.

The Church of Serra is now led by Lyra Dawnbringer . The Order of Dawn , led by Lyra herself, protects Benalia . The Aven Order of the Ancestor is an order dedicated to the belief that Serra and the Ancestor worshipped on the continent of Otaria are the same. And are mostly comprised of Avens who escaped Otaria

There are also orders devoted to the four virtues and the five points of balance. There is even a Order of Akroma , which mistakingly considers Akroma to have been a Serra Angel. Others believe that Serra's Blessing contributed to Gerrard Capashen 's defeat of Yawgmoth .
The Knights of Sursi are the defenders of the Cathedral of Sursi, while the Defenders of the Temple make regular pilgrimages to the Temple of Serra at Epityr.
